title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-TRANSFORMERS-14564366 in transformers@5.5.0
description:
## Arbitrary Code Injection

**Severity:** high
**Package:** transformers@5.5.0
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 8.5  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 425/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2025-14927](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-14927)

**Fix:** No automatic fix available. Review manually.

### Details
## Overview
[transformers](https://pypi.org/project/transformers) is a State-of-the-art Machine Learning for JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Arbitrary Code Injection via the `convert_config` function. An attacker can execute arbitrary code by supplying a malicious checkpoint file that is processed without proper validation.

**Note:**

The report of this vulnerability was rejected by the package's maintainers. See the project's [security policy](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/security) for more information.
## Remediation
There is no fixed version for `transformers`.
